method: Independent visual examination of original pilot clips using host FFmpeg frame extraction; no OCR or pipeline artifacts used as truth.
frame_interval_convention: Zero-based frames; start included and end excluded. All clips are 1920x1080 at 24 fps. Times in main annotation files are local clip times.
geometry_warning: Representative quadrilaterals are approximate manual annotations. They support explicit flagged nearby fallback coverage checks; they do not establish accepted two-pixel tracking accuracy.
